actions.title: Find the IRS CP 575 letter for FullControl
actions.why: Every field on the Twilio form is copied character for character off this one letter. It is the single source of truth, and getting a field wrong burns one of only 3 free submissions.
actions.whyHuman: It is your business paperwork, in your email or with your accountant.
steps: Search your email, your accountant, and the company formation documents
Save it as a PDF, you will need the file itself if the submission gets rejected
If it is gone, phone the IRS and request a 147C replacement, then tell me immediately because it adds unknown days
Note the EIN issue date from the top right of the letter
actions.verify: You have a PDF of the CP 575 open on screen showing legal name, EIN and address.
actions.never: Do not copy the legal name off a W2 or W9. Their formatting differs and a mismatch is its own rejection.

actions.title: Set up the authorised rep email and details
actions.why: A free or generic email address is a documented cause of brand rejection. The rep's email domain has to match the business.
steps: Create or confirm an email address on the FullControl domain
Not gmail, not outlook, and not a shared address like info@
Have ready: your real name, real job title, the job position from Twilio's dropdown (CEO, Director, and so on)
Have your phone in the +1XXXXXXXXXX format
actions.verify: You can send and receive from the FullControl-domain address.

actions.title: Get the FullControl website live
actions.why: This is the real long pole, not Twilio. A parked page or a bare landing page is exactly what triggers rejection error 18601.
actions.whyHuman: Your call on scope and content.
steps: Point it at a custom FullControl domain, not a vercel.app or similar
Make sure it is publicly reachable: not parked, not password protected, no redirect elsewhere
The legal business name AND the logo must be visible on the page
Privacy policy and terms are NOT needed for this step, they come later at campaign time
actions.verify: Open the site in a private browsing window. It loads, and you can see the legal entity name and logo without logging in.

actions.title: Create the Twilio account and submit the profile
actions.why: This starts the clock. A clean submission comes back within 48 hours.
actions.whyHuman: Account creation, billing and the legal attestation are all yours.
steps: Sign up for the new Twilio account, upgrade off trial, add a billing method
Open the Primary Business Profile form with your CP 575 PDF open beside it
Business identity: pick ISV / Reseller / Partner, NOT Direct Customer
Vertical: EDUCATION
Enter the address using the Console autocomplete rather than typing it, so it matches USPS records
Copy each field off the CP 575 exactly, then submit
actions.verify: Twilio shows the profile as submitted or pending review. Check back Saturday.
actions.never: Never use a DUNS number for a US entity, and never abbreviate the legal name or add a DBA. You only get 3 free submissions.

actions.title: Only if rejected: file the appeal
actions.why: Twilio explicitly names newly issued tax IDs as a valid appeal reason, which is our exact situation since the EIN is roughly 60 to 90 days old.
actions.whyHuman: Requires your Twilio support login and payment.
steps: Open a Twilio Support ticket referencing the profile SID
Attach the CP 575 as a PDF
Ask for the submission to be appealed to manual vetting
Pay the $10 fee
actions.verify: Approval typically lands 5 to 7 business days later, around August 12.

actions.title: On approval: hand me the four values
actions.why: One of them, the primary profile SID, is the single flag that un-gates the whole automated phone chain in the portal.
actions.whyHuman: They live in your Twilio console.
steps: From the new Twilio account, copy the master Account SID
Create an API key and copy the API Key SID and the API Key Secret
Copy the approved Primary Profile SID
Send them to me and I will set them on Vercel and smoke test the chain
actions.verify: I confirm the env vars are set on both production and preview and one academy passes a smoke test.
actions.never: Do not paste the API Key Secret into a public place. Send it in the chat only when you are ready for me to set it.
